CrmSync.title: CRM sync
CrmSync.description: CRM integrations, field mapping and the state of the last sync. The internal CRM remains the source of truth.

errors.file_malformed: The file is not a readable CSV (UTF-8, quotes).

CrmSync.rule: On a conflict (both sides changed), the field's source of truth wins and the loser is recorded in the audit log.
